candidate_semantic_models.description: Retained V5 and a dehydrated manifest expose exact projected units; the manifest is a retained custody and availability index, not necessarily the owner of projection semantics.
A shared projection request selects exact units and delegates byte resolution to mode-specific retained-object or live-session resolvers.
Common projection-unit, selection, accounting, privacy, and citation semantics are shared while retained manifests and live requests retain distinct custody identities and resolver contracts.

semantic_design_barrier.selected_model_scope: Shared logical projected-unit, selection, accounting, privacy, range, and citation semantics compose with and specialize Select -> Resolve -> Assemble. Retained V5 and live session-generation custody keep distinct Resolve contracts, physical projection identities, statuses, admission identities, and cache identities.
semantic_design_barrier.identity_rule: The same logical unit, including identical source bytes, does not imply retained/live projection identity, semantic-admission identity, or cache equality.
semantic_design_barrier.wire_decisions: D1-D12 remain pending the canonical cross-mode fixture and golden vectors; no public schema, identity preimage, status precedence, privacy vocabulary, or schema version is frozen by model selection.
required_comparison_evidence: exact TARGET and NEIGHBORHOOD request/result examples for retained-object and live-session custody
Describe, Embed, and index-build admission examples using the same logical projected unit under each candidate model
identity and cache-key vectors proving equality only for exact admitted bytes, selector, range, encoding, role, revision or session generation, policy, and dependency identity
privacy and source-body eligibility matrix for metadata-only, body-opted-in, restricted, withheld, unavailable, and ancillary units
failure and denominator examples showing TARGET, NEIGHBORHOOD, partial, and CENSUS claims do not broaden coverage
operation-43 live evidence capable of changing the shared projection-unit contract before model freeze
semantic_design_barrier.selection_rule: HYBRID_SHARED_ALGEBRA is selected as the design model. Qualification remains NOT_EXECUTED, and no common wire contract, retained/live implementation admission, semantic-index cache formula, or operation-43 projection contract freezes until the canonical cross-mode fixture and D1-D12 golden vectors are reviewed.
semantic_design_barrier.non_dependency_rule: Retained qualification is not a hard semantic prerequisite for learning from bounded operation-43 live projection evidence; custody-specific implementation admission remains independently gated.

barrier_rule: A qualification track passes only when every cell in that track has attributable PASS evidence at one reviewed revision. Documentation, BLOCKED, FAIL, NOT_RUN, or mixed-revision evidence never qualifies implementation.

operation_boundaries.36: location-only transient contract unless a separately qualified additive version is selected
operation_boundaries.43: location-only transient facade unless a separately qualified additive version is selected

manifest_track: canonical candidate manifest bytes, digest, semantic-validation result, and exact V5 binding
ordered retained availability inventory with source identity, storage class, qualification, privacy class, availability, role, graph subject, range, encoding, and custody
schema digest inventory proving additive-only registration
explicit statement whether the manifest is only a retained custody/availability index or also instantiates selected shared projection semantics
object_store_track: pinned-root canonical-selector and exact-byte resolver contracts
GIT_BLOB, CONTENT_ADDRESS, EMBEDDED_IMMUTABLE, and UNAVAILABLE receipts
owner-only, no raw root disclosure, atomic no-replace, retention, lease, and GC evidence
missing, corrupt, withheld, neighbor-byte, shallow-history, rewritten-history, and collected-object outcomes
byte, object, read-work, response, and page boundary evidence
live_session_track: exact managed session ID and generation authority
exact document URI/version/content identity and position encoding admitted for the request
proof that live resolution reads only request-admitted documents and performs no retained-object or current-checkout fallback
separate structural and projection budget/status accounting
partial graph/frontier and source-unit disposition evidence
adr0007_semantic_track: typed admission identity and canonicalization policy
Describe, Embed, and index-build dependency/cache identity formulas
privacy, retention, deletion, invalidation, and source-body eligibility policies
authority-zero, accepted-false, no-CALLS, and no-graph-facts claim guards

cells.pass_evidence: Every projected unit has exact role, graph subject, logical source identity, exact range, position encoding, source digest/length, custody-mode identity, privacy class, availability, and policy identity; input permutation yields byte-identical canonical output.
cells.fail_evidence: Identity omits a field that can change selected bytes or authority context, or ordering depends on input/map order.

cells.pass_evidence: UTF-8/16/32, BOM, CR/LF/CRLF, non-BMP, empty and cross-line vectors preserve whole endpoint and relation ranges; overlap may share emitted spans only while every original selection remains attributable and citeable to its exact node or server-reported CALLS relation.
cells.fail_evidence: Range is guessed, repaired, shortened, widened, split, role-swapped, or loses independent citation attribution.

cells.pass_evidence: Canonical role/subject/source/range/digest order is stable; candidates=selected+omitted; one mutually exclusive reason exists per omission; object/node, range, bytes, work, response, page, and page-count limits admit whole ranges and report exact observed/limit values where safe.
cells.fail_evidence: Accounting does not reconcile, zero becomes unlimited, pages reset budgets, a range fragments, a hidden increase/retry occurs, or the wrong resource is reported.

cells.pass_evidence: Source additions/removals/reordering/text/overlap change only projection data; graph bytes, nodes, relations, support, authority=0, accepted=false, source_graph_complete=UNKNOWN, and graph_facts_added=0 remain invariant.
cells.fail_evidence: Source or semantic output creates/repairs/removes CALLS or another graph fact, strengthens authority/completeness, or becomes accepted evidence.

cells.pass_evidence: Metadata-only is default; body eligibility requires explicit opt-in plus policy; restricted, withheld, ancillary, unavailable, and unauthorized units remain omitted with discoverable accounting; private roots, arbitrary paths, secrets, commands, environment, and raw errors never leak.
cells.fail_evidence: Digest authorizes disclosure, body appears by default, privacy class is lost, COMPLETE_CAPTURE bypasses policy, or private locator data is public.

cells.pass_evidence: Named compiling RED mutations for unknown/duplicate/missing fields, invalid identity/range/encoding/privacy/status/limits and reordered/mixed pages fail at the intended assertion with no repaired output, retry, fallback, broader policy, or implicit continuation.
cells.fail_evidence: Mutation passes, fails only in setup/compilation, reaches an unrelated assertion, or is normalized to success.

cells.pass_evidence: A manifest candidate, when used, binds exact admitted V5 schema ID/digest/length/capture identity and exact retained availability entries without owning or strengthening graph semantics; predecessor schema bytes and V2/V3 readers remain unchanged.
cells.fail_evidence: Manifest binds another graph, silently upgrades V2/V3, mutates predecessor bytes, or claims general semantic ownership not selected at the barrier.

cells.pass_evidence: Committed source resolves only exact commit/tree/blob; dirty/non-Git source resolves only retained immutable objects; digest-only dirty source is unavailable; exact length/digest/custody are verified before extraction.
cells.fail_evidence: Current checkout, sibling bytes, mutable path, URI, version, digest-only record, or alternate class satisfies retrieval.
blockers: Git pinning or dirty-buffer receipt absent

cells.pass_evidence: Missing/corrupt/withheld/collected/shallow/rewritten objects produce exact terminal outcomes without current-checkout, live-session, provider, network, retry, or resolver fallthrough; graph and manifest remain valid custody metadata.
cells.fail_evidence: Fallback or substitution occurs, manifest is rewritten, or unavailable/withheld/corrupt is mislabeled as budget truncation.
blockers: resolver instrumentation or GC policy absent

cells.pass_evidence: Owner-only pinned-root publication is atomic no-replace with one race winner; fresh offline replay from exact V5, availability index/manifest, source objects, policy, and limits is byte-identical and stable; missing/mixed/tampered/reordered inputs fail without ambient access.
cells.fail_evidence: Caller path controls storage, existing bytes change, loser succeeds, replay differs or uses hidden cache/workspace/session/network.
blockers: publication receipt or replay packet absent

cells.pass_evidence: Every source unit binds the exact managed session ID/generation and request-admitted document identity/version/bytes/encoding; resolution reads only those admitted live bytes and never retained objects or ambient checkout paths.
cells.fail_evidence: Generation drift, document substitution, retained-object fallback, current-checkout read, or post-request changed buffer satisfies the request.
blockers: future additive live contract not selected

cells.pass_evidence: Body/range/object/work/page consumption cannot consume structural request/message/node/depth/traversal-byte budgets; each exhausted resource is named; projection status cannot hide or rewrite structural TRUNCATED/RESOURCE_LIMIT and reports partial graph/frontier disposition.
cells.fail_evidence: Budgets pool, body opt-in changes structural graph/status/frontier, failures are opaque, or hidden retry/increase occurs.
blockers: separate accounting and frontier semantics unresolved

cells.pass_evidence: Bounded operation-43 TARGET/snippet trials run before common-contract freeze and record whether live constraints require changes to shared unit identity, selection, citations, privacy, limits, or status semantics; accepted changes are requalified in common and retained tracks.
cells.fail_evidence: Common semantics freeze before live evidence, operation-43 evidence is ignored because retained is incomplete, or live semantics silently diverge.

cells.pass_evidence: Host-owned parameter help appears only for request-validation errors, never valid typed domain failures; omitted projection fields preserve legacy bytes; explicit body opt-in changes projection only and never makes transient results retained, replayable, publishable, or hydration-eligible.
cells.fail_evidence: Expected parameters decorates a domain failure, omitted fields drift, body opt-in changes structural outcomes, or transient custody is upgraded.

cells.pass_evidence: Exact projected source units can be admitted as finite ADR 0007 item types for TARGET, bounded NEIGHBORHOOD, Describe, Embed, and index-build without implying CENSUS; each admission retains corpus/type, exact bytes or immutable selector, range, role, source identity, custody mode, revision/generation, authority, acceptance, privacy, and derivation.
cells.fail_evidence: Admission loses source-unit identity/citation, treats TARGET/NEIGHBORHOOD as CENSUS, or semantic worker retrieves beyond caller-admitted bytes/relationships.
blockers: cross-ADR item type and semantic model unselected

cells.pass_evidence: Cache hit occurs only when projected unit identity, exact bytes/selector, range, encoding, role, custody identity, revision/generation, representation, prompts, model/runtime, policies, and ordered dependencies are exactly equal; any change yields a new immutable record and downstream invalidation/rebuild disposition.
cells.fail_evidence: Approximate, digest-only-without-bytes, family-level, cross-revision, cross-generation, cross-custody, or policy-family match hits cache.

cells.pass_evidence: Describe/search/group/work-context outputs cite exact projected endpoint declaration or relation call-site units and their immutable admission identities; relation citations remain attached only to admitted server-reported CALLS and endpoint citations never substitute for call sites.
cells.fail_evidence: Citation points only to file/name/text, loses range/role/custody, invents CALLS, or treats endpoint and relation ranges as interchangeable.

cells.pass_evidence: Live-session units enter explicitly typed working context with generation/currentness; retained V5-bound units enter revision-bound code/structural evidence with exact custody; coexistence preserves distinctions and never silently mixes revisions or upgrades working context to retained authority.
cells.fail_evidence: Live bytes inherit retained custody, retained bytes are labeled current live state, revisions/generations mix silently, or similarity equalizes authority.

cells.pass_evidence: Every semantic result exposes TARGET/NEIGHBORHOOD/CENSUS mode, exact scope, denominator, evaluated and terminal counts, failures/exclusions, revision policy, and coverage; partial/zero/bounded results make no absence, repository completeness, domain completeness, feature identity, or work-complete claim.
cells.fail_evidence: TARGET or NEIGHBORHOOD implies census, non-COMPLETE omits denominator/evaluated state, or zero results imply absence beyond admitted scope.

cells.pass_evidence: Descriptions, embeddings, indexes, searches, groups, and generated context always retain authority=0 and accepted=false; source authority metadata remains separate; outputs cannot add/suppress/repair CALLS, nodes, relations, support, graph facts, structural status, or completeness.
cells.fail_evidence: Generated output inherits source authority/acceptance, manufactures CALLS or graph facts, overwrites lineage/evidence, or establishes feature/design correctness.

cells.pass_evidence: Only policy-eligible source bodies become semantic representations; metadata-only, restricted, withheld, unavailable, and ancillary cases remain typed; derived descriptions/embeddings/indexes/queries/caches/logs inherit explicit sensitive-data handling; deletion invalidates and accounts for all dependent artifacts without stale reappearance.
cells.fail_evidence: Indexing bypasses body opt-in/privacy, withheld bytes are reconstructed, derived artifacts escape retention/deletion policy, or tombstoned data reappears from cache.

cells.pass_evidence: Registry/capability goldens retain exactly 43 canonical operations, 13 compact tools, no operation 44, additive schema identities only, unchanged predecessor hashes, operation 33 retained-only, operation 41 unchanged, and no ADR 0007 public CLI/MCP/core integration.
cells.fail_evidence: Count drift, operation 44, predecessor mutation, source-snapshot reinterpretation, operation-41 flags, operation-33 transient bodies, or ADR 0007 integration into core surfaces occurs.

cells.pass_evidence: Equivalent direct inspect-hydrated and canonical execute requests produce byte-identical delegated envelopes, accounting, pages/bodies, and typed failures; any future operation-43/36 direct/gateway exposure independently proves the same parity without host rendering conflation.
cells.fail_evidence: Transport changes defaults, numbers, ordering, privacy, body opt-in, cursors, failure codes, or accounting.

claim_ceiling: This matrix records a documentation-only design-model selection while qualification remains NOT_EXECUTED. It does not claim that implementation exists; claim any test ran or passed; change any qualification cell to PASS; qualify retained or live projection, a manifest, an object store, operation 43/36, or ADR 0007 interoperability; freeze D1-D12 or public wire vocabulary; or authorize schemas, operations, inference, indexing, shipment, deployment, or production behavior.
